name: KoalaWriter
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For KoalaWriter, create source-grounded article drafts with reusable presets and automatic internal outlines. The hard boundary is live serp retrieval, model routing, wordpress publishing, and bulk workflows, plus workflow, data, and model tuning.
